description.value:
Supporting one ally with a Skill or Ultimate grants that ally Hymn: +1 damage per stack, maximum 3, for 3 turns. Gain 2 Energy per qualifying use; every second use restores 1 SP.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching harmony Path required.
